import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.ChiUnconditional
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.SectionBounds

universe u
open AlgebraicGeometry Adelic

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)

/-- CONVERSE of `exists_bound_h1dim_eq_zero_of_charts`: its hypothesis is
EQUIVALENT to its conclusion, so it transports no information. -/
theorem converse_exists_bound (hcov : U₀ ⊔ U₁ = ⊤) (b : ℤ)
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₀ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₁ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k (U₀ ⊓ U₁) D)]
    (hvan : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, b ≤ degK k D → h1dim k U₀ U₁ D = 0) :
    ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, b ≤ degK k D →
      (Module.finrank k (sectionSub k U₀ D) : ℤ)
        + Module.finrank k (sectionSub k U₁ D)
        - Module.finrank k (sectionSub k (U₀ ⊓ U₁) D) = (ell k D : ℤ) :=
  fun D hD => (h1dim_eq_zero_iff_charts k U₀ U₁ hcov D).mp (hvan D hD)

/-- `ChartCountsDegree` is *literally* the ledger hypothesis of
`SectionBounds.degK_principal_eq_zero`; the "chart" version is an alpha-rename. -/
theorem chartCounts_is_hledger :
    ChartCountsDegree k U₀ U₁ ↔ (∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D) :=
  Iff.rfl

example (hcount : ChartCountsDegree k U₀ U₁) {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    degK k (Scheme.WeilDivisor.principal g hg) = 0 :=
  degK_principal_eq_zero k U₀ U₁ hcount hg   -- old theorem accepts the "new" hypothesis verbatim

/-- The off-overlap theorems force `U₀ ≠ ⊤`, and a prime divisor sitting off `U₀`
means the complement of `U₀` contains a codim-1 point.  Meanwhile
`sectionSub k U₀ E` is then UNBOUNDED in the pole order along `P`:
every `L(m·P + E)` global section lands in it, for every `m ≥ 0`. -/
theorem chart_contains_all_pole_orders {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U₀)
    (E : X.WeilDivisor) (m : ℕ) :
    sectionSub k (⊤ : X.Opens) (m • pointDivisor P + E) ≤ sectionSub k U₀ E := by
  intro f hf
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  refine Or.inr fun Q hQ => ?_
  have hQP : Q ≠ P := fun h => hP (h ▸ hQ)
  have := (mem_sectionOfDivisor_of_ne_zero hf0).mp hf Q (by trivial)
  have hcoef : (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from (m • pointDivisor P + E)) Q
      = (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from E) Q := by
    simp [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, pointDivisor_apply_of_ne _ hQP]
  rwa [hcoef] at this

universe u
open AlgebraicGeometry Adelic

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ : X.Opens)

/-- **Global sections of every divisor in the tower `n·P + E` sit inside the single
chart space `Γ(U₀,𝒪(E))`, when `P.point ∉ U₀`.** -/
theorem top_tower_le_chart {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U₀)
    (E : X.WeilDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
    sectionSub k (⊤ : X.Opens) (n • pointDivisor P + E) ≤ sectionSub k U₀ E := by
  intro f hf
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  refine Or.inr fun Q hQ => ?_
  have hQP : Q ≠ P := fun h => hP (h ▸ hQ)
  have h := (mem_sectionOfDivisor_of_ne_zero hf0).mp hf Q (by trivial)
  have hcoef : (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from (n • pointDivisor P + E)) Q
      = (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from E) Q := by
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      pointDivisor, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hQP)]
    simp
  rwa [hcoef] at h

/-- **Chart finiteness caps `ℓ` uniformly along the tower.**  So
`Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₀ E)` is INCOMPATIBLE with the Riemann inequality
`n·[κ(P):k] + χ(0) ≤ ℓ(n·P + E)` whenever `P.point ∉ U₀`: the right side is bounded. -/
theorem ell_bounded_of_chart_finite {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U₀)
    (E : X.WeilDivisor) [Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₀ E)] (n : ℕ) :
    ell k (n • pointDivisor P + E) ≤ Module.finrank k (sectionSub k U₀ E) := by
  rw [ell]
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (R := k) (top_tower_le_chart k U₀ hP E n)
EOF
